Hi Rishi,

Quick question on how Redwood will invoice us after the go-live on Nov 1. ConcertBio is an Italian-registered company (VAT IT12345678901) but we also have a UK branch that handles UK contracts (ConcertBio UK Ltd, VAT GB987654321). For accounting we need either: 1) a single consolidated invoice that shows two line items (one billed to IT entity with Italian VAT reverse-charge handling, one billed to UK entity with VAT treatment for cross-border services), or 2) separate invoices to each legal entity.

We also need confirmation on:
- Whether Redwood can accept a single payment that nets both invoices (our treasury prefers one wire) and how to map that to two legal entities in your records;
- What specific VAT evidence you require for reverse-charge (we can provide a VAT certificate and VIES printout); and
- Wire instructions for SEPA (EUR) and GBP payments — which accounts to use so our AR can route correctly.

I attached our VAT certificate. Please also flag if you need any additional supporting docs for our auditors.

Thanks,
Elena

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and the VAT cert. Short answers up front: we can do either consolidated invoice with split line items or separate invoices; and we can accept a single payment and allocate it across entities if you provide a remittance note mapping amounts to each entity.

Details below and next steps:
1) VAT evidence we need for reverse-charge on the Italian-side:
   - Valid VAT number (you provided) + VIES verification (we typically capture a VIES screenshot).
   - Contract showing the place of supply if services are digital (basic note on cross-border supply helps our tax team).
   - Confirmation the Italian entity is the recipient of services for accounting purposes.
2) UK treatment: if the UK branch is billed directly we will apply the livestreamed VAT handling based on place of supply; if the UK branch is buying from the IT entity, that becomes an internal allocation which complicates VAT — usually cleaner to have Redwood invoice the billed legal entity directly.
3) Wire instructions: we have separate collections accounts for EUR/GBP. Ive attached our standard wire stub; Hannah in billing will confirm final account ids.

Next steps: can you confirm which option you prefer (single consolidated invoice with remittance mapping, or separate invoices)? If consolidated, please provide the exact VAT IDs and target invoice names for both entities in the remittance mapping. Once we have that, Billing (ccd) will prepare the pro forma and include separate tax lines.

Im looping in Lauren (legal) for the minimal wording we need in the contract to support place-of-supply, and Marissa on the AR side to confirm billing cadence and any deal-level adjustments.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Total (separate tax lines): EUR 24,000 + GBP 6,000
